```{r load-baseballr, echo=FALSE}
library(baseballr)
```


```{r pitchers, echo=FALSE}
bullpen_pitchers <- c("Jansen, Kenley", "Kimbrel, Craig")

start_date <- "2024-03-26"
end_date   <- "2024-10-04"
```


```{r lookup-ids, echo=FALSE}
pitcher_lookup <- tibble(full_name = bullpen_pitchers) %>%
  separate(full_name, into = c("last_name", "first_name"), sep = ",\\s*")

pitcher_ids <- pmap_dfr(pitcher_lookup, function(last_name, first_name) {
  playerid_lookup(last_name = last_name, first_name = first_name) %>%
    filter(!is.na(fangraphs_id)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    mutate(Pitcher = paste0(last_name, ", ", first_name)) %>%
    select(Pitcher, fangraphs_id)
})

if (nrow(pitcher_ids) < length(bullpen_pitchers)) {
  warning("Could not find a FanGraphs ID for one or more pitchers - check spelling/format.")
}

pitcher_ids
```


```{r pull-fangraphs, echo=FALSE}
years <- seq(
  as.integer(format(as.Date(start_date), "%Y")),
  as.integer(format(as.Date(end_date), "%Y"))
)

pitcher_year <- tidyr::crossing(pitcher_ids, season = years)

fg_raw <- pmap_dfr(pitcher_year, function(Pitcher, fangraphs_id, season) {
  fg_pitcher_game_logs(playerid = fangraphs_id, year = season) %>%
    mutate(Pitcher = Pitcher)
})
```


```{r map-columns, echo=FALSE}
ip_to_outs <- function(ip) {
  whole  <- floor(ip)
  thirds <- round((ip - whole) * 10)  # .1 -> 1 out, .2 -> 2 outs
  whole * 3 + thirds
}

pitcher_game <- fg_raw %>%
  transmute(
    Date    = as.Date(Date),
    Pitcher = Pitcher,
    Outs    = ip_to_outs(as.numeric(IP)),
    ER      = as.numeric(ER)
  ) %>%
  filter(Date >= as.Date(start_date), Date <= as.Date(end_date)) %>%
  filter(Pitcher %in% bullpen_pitchers) %>%
  arrange(Pitcher, Date)
```


```{r rest-days, echo=FALSE}
pitcher_game <- pitcher_game %>%
  group_by(Pitcher) %>%
  mutate(
    Prev_Date       = lag(Date),
    Days_Since_Last = as.numeric(Date - Prev_Date),
    Rest_Days       = Days_Since_Last - 1,
    Rest_Category = case_when(
      is.na(Rest_Days)  ~ "First Outing (Unknown Rest)",
      Rest_Days <= 0    ~ "No Days Rest",   # covers same-day (doubleheader) outings too
      Rest_Days == 1    ~ "One Day Rest",
      Rest_Days >= 2    ~ "Multiple Days Rest",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

rest_order <- c("No Days Rest", "One Day Rest", "Multiple Days Rest")
```


```{r helpers, echo=FALSE}
calc_era <- function(er, outs) {
  ifelse(outs == 0, NA_real_, round(27 * er / outs, 2))
}

# Traditional baseball IP notation, e.g. 6 outs remainder 1 -> "6.1"
format_ip <- function(outs) {
  paste0(outs %/% 3, ".", outs %% 3)
}
```


```{r era-by-rest, echo=FALSE}
era_by_pitcher_rest <- pitcher_game %>%
  filter(Rest_Category != "First Outing (Unknown Rest)") %>%
  group_by(Pitcher, Rest_Category) %>%
  summarise(
    Outs = sum(Outs),
    ER   = sum(ER),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    IP  = format_ip(Outs),
    ERA = calc_era(ER, Outs)
  ) %>%
  select(Pitcher, Rest_Category, IP, ER, ERA)
```


```{r pitcher-tables, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
for (p in bullpen_pitchers) {

  cat("### ", p, "\n\n")

  tbl <- era_by_pitcher_rest %>%
    filter(Pitcher == p) %>%
    mutate(Rest_Category = factor(Rest_Category, levels = rest_order)) %>%
    arrange(Rest_Category) %>%
    select(Rest_Category, IP, ER, ERA) %>%
    mutate(Rest_Category = as.character(Rest_Category))

  overall <- pitcher_game %>%
    filter(Pitcher == p) %>%
    summarise(Outs = sum(Outs), ER = sum(ER)) %>%
    transmute(
      Rest_Category = "Overall",
      IP  = format_ip(Outs),
      ER  = ER,
      ERA = calc_era(ER, Outs)
    )

  tbl <- bind_rows(tbl, overall)

  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) {
    cat("No data found for this pitcher.\n\n")
  } else {
    print(kable(tbl, col.names = c("Rest Situation", "IP", "ER", "ERA")))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```


```{r overall-by-rest, echo=FALSE}
overall_by_rest <- pitcher_game %>%
  filter(Rest_Category != "First Outing (Unknown Rest)") %>%
  group_by(Rest_Category) %>%
  summarise(Outs = sum(Outs), ER = sum(ER), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Rest_Category = factor(Rest_Category, levels = rest_order)) %>%
  arrange(Rest_Category) %>%
  mutate(
    IP  = format_ip(Outs),
    ERA = calc_era(ER, Outs)
  ) %>%
  select(Rest_Category, IP, ER, ERA)

kable(overall_by_rest,
      col.names = c("Rest Situation", "IP", "ER", "ERA"),
      caption = "Bullpen ERA by Rest Situation (All Pitchers Combined)")
```


```{r overall-era, echo=FALSE}
overall_bullpen <- pitcher_game %>%
  summarise(Outs = sum(Outs), ER = sum(ER)) %>%
  mutate(
    IP  = format_ip(Outs),
    ERA = calc_era(ER, Outs)
  )

kable(overall_bullpen %>% select(IP, ER, ERA),
      caption = "Overall Bullpen ERA")
```
